selection: Real fix commits from each repository history. A task starts at the commit before the fix; its check is the tests that came with the fix. Every task is proven by benchmarks/validate_tasks.py to fail with no agent work and pass with the reference change; see validation.json.

tasks.title: show_envvar with a sequence or empty envvar
tasks.prompt: When an option uses `show_envvar=True`, its error message and help output are wrong in two cases. If `envvar` is a sequence of names, the message shows the Python repr of the sequence instead of the variable names. If `envvar` is empty, such as `[]` or `""`, the help shows `[env var: ]`. Make an empty `envvar` behave exactly like no `envvar`, and list each variable name of a sequence.

tasks.title: Zsh completion items containing colons
tasks.prompt: Shell completion for the Z shell (zsh) breaks when a completion item contains a colon, because zsh treats an unescaped colon as the separator between a value and its description. Make zsh completion output correct for items that contain colons.

tasks.title: Option to hide the progress bar
tasks.prompt: Add a way to hide a progress bar entirely. A progress bar created with `click.progressbar(...)` should have a `hidden` attribute (also accepted by the `ProgressBar` constructor). When `hidden` is true, iterating or updating the bar must work as usual but write nothing to the output, even on a terminal.

tasks.title: multiple=True for flag options
tasks.prompt: Allow `multiple=True` on boolean flag options again, without requiring `default=()`. Passing such a flag several times should collect one value per occurrence, and the default when the flag is not passed should be an empty tuple.

tasks.title: Return value and signature of add_completion_class
tasks.prompt: Refactor `click.shell_completion.add_completion_class` so it can be used as a decorator: it must return the class it registers, and its type signature should express that the same class type is returned. Registering a completion class must keep working as before.

tasks.title: Hide the internal UNSET sentinel in lookup_default
tasks.prompt: `Context.lookup_default()` can return click's internal `Sentinel.UNSET` marker to callers. Refactor it so the internal sentinel never leaks: callers see `None` when there is no default, while an explicit override of `lookup_default` in a subclass is still respected.

tasks.title: Copy, deepcopy and pickle of Sentinel members
tasks.prompt: Members of click's internal `Sentinel` enum must keep their identity when copied: `copy.copy`, `copy.deepcopy` and a `pickle` round trip should return the same member object. Today this breaks `copy.deepcopy()` and `pickle` of a `Parameter`, `Option` or `Command`. Refactor the sentinel so these operations preserve identity.

tasks.title: Tests for show_default with non-string defaults
tasks.prompt: The help output for an option with `show_default=True` treats an empty-string default specially. That check must only apply to real strings: a default value whose type compares equal to `""` without being a string must be rendered normally. The code already handles this. Add tests to `tests/test_options.py` that cover this behaviour, so that they would catch a regression.

tasks.title: pass_context tests with the select filter
tasks.prompt: Tests decorated with `@pass_context` fail when used through the `select` filter (and related filters such as `reject`): the context is not passed. Make context-receiving tests work with these filters.

tasks.title: Reject invalid characters in xmlattr keys
tasks.prompt: The `xmlattr` filter already rejects keys containing spaces. It must also reject keys containing `/`, `>` or `=`, which could otherwise break out of the attribute context. Raise an error for such keys, as for keys with spaces.

tasks.title: Subscripts after filters and calls in async mode
tasks.prompt: When the environment is in async mode, subscripting the result of a filter, test or call, such as `{{ (x|f)[0] }}` or `{{ f()[0] }}`, does not work, because the awaited value is subscripted before it is awaited. Make subscripts after filters, tests and calls work in async mode.

tasks.title: PackageLoader with a single-module package
tasks.prompt: `PackageLoader` only works when the package is a directory. Support packages that are a single module file, loading templates from the templates directory next to that module, including listing them.

tasks.title: Tests for sandbox protection of clear and pop
tasks.prompt: The sandboxed environment treats `clear` and `pop` on known mutable sequence types as unsafe operations, so the immutable sandbox forbids them. The code already does this. Add tests to `tests/test_security.py` that would catch a regression where these methods are allowed again.

tasks.title: Settings must ignore Object.prototype values
tasks.prompt: `app.get(setting)`, `app.enabled()` and `app.disabled()` read inherited values from `Object.prototype`, so settings named like built-in properties (for example `constructor` or `hasOwnProperty`) look set. Only the app's own settings, and those inherited from a parent app, should count.

tasks.title: Tests for res.location with non-string values
tasks.prompt: `res.location(url)` converts its argument to a string, so a `URL` instance or another non-string value works. The code already does this. Add tests to `test/res.location.js` that would catch a regression to string-only handling.
